verification_report.summary: The full proof passes: 62 deductions across 14 proof items and seven reference groups were checked. The affine trace homeomorphism, mean-normalized compactness, smooth zero-mass singleton, exact Green admissibility condition, complete bounded-Lipschitz metric, and uniform equivalence are valid for arbitrary smooth nonclosed theta without a top-degree mass bound. The curve counterexample correctly uses the positive-background setting of the accepted curve theorem; mean normalization and exponential damping justify failure of capacity convergence.
